questions.question: Which flagship rural employment scheme has been renamed as Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission - Gramin (VB G RAM G) with an increase in guaranteed workdays to 125 days per household?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet has approved the renaming of MGNREGS as Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission - Gramin **(VB G RAM G)** and increased guaranteed employment from 100 to 125 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The scheme now guarantees 125 days of wage employment per rural household annually.**
 
• **The renaming marks the second change in the scheme’s identity since its launch.**
 
• **The reform aims to strengthen rural livelihoods and enhance income security.**
 
• **The programme continues to be administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Evolution of the Scheme__

 __
 
• Originally launched as National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS).
 
• Renamed Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) in 2009.
 
• Renamed again as Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission - Gramin (VB G RAM G) under the latest reform.
 
 
 
• Objectives of the Programme__
 __
 
• Provides legal guarantee of wage employment to rural households.
 
• Enhances livelihood security through demand-driven employment.
 
• Supports creation of durable rural assets.
 
 
 
• Administrative Framework__
 
 
• Implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• Plays a central role in rural poverty alleviation and employment assurance.
 
• One of the world’s largest social security and public works programmes.

questions.question: What is the maximum foreign direct investment (FDI) permitted in insurance companies under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Insurance Laws Amendment) Bill, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**100 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Parliament passed the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Insurance Laws Amendment) Bill, 2025.**
 
• **The Bill aims to expand insurance coverage and strengthen the insurance sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Bill allows up to 100 percent foreign direct investment in insurance companies.**
 
• **This change opens the sector to greater foreign participation.**
 
• **It facilitates capital expansion and adoption of global best practices.**
 
• **Higher FDI is expected to enhance competition and service efficiency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Acts Amended**__ – Insurance Act, 1938; LIC Act, 1956; and IRDAI Act, 1999.
 
• The Bill promotes ease of doing business through one-time licensing for intermediaries.
 
• Net owned fund requirement for foreign reinsurance branches reduced from ₹5,000 crore to ₹1,000 crore.
 
• A Policyholder Education and Protection Fund will be created to spread insurance awareness.

3f

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana launched by the Punjab government?

options.text: It provides free cashless medical treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family across Punjab
It is applicable only to senior citizens and government employees
It covers treatment exclusively in government hospitals without private sector participation
It is limited only to below poverty line families with an annual cover of ₹5 lakh

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It provides free cashless medical treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family across Punjab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Punjab government launched the Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana, a universal health insurance scheme offering cashless treatment up to ₹10 lakh per family.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana provides free cashless healthcare coverage of up to ₹10 lakh per family.**
 
• The scheme covers all 65 lakh families in Punjab, benefiting nearly three crore residents.
 
• Eligibility requires possession of an Aadhaar card and voter card, making it a universal scheme.
 
• More than 2,500 medical procedures are covered across government and empanelled private hospitals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana__

 __
 
• A universal health insurance initiative launched by the Punjab government.
 
• Aims to ensure free and quality healthcare for every resident of the state.
 
 
 
• Cashless Healthcare__
 __
 
• Allows patients to receive treatment without paying upfront costs.
 
• Expenses are settled directly between hospitals and the government or insurer.
 
 
 
• Universal Health Coverage__
 __
 
• Ensures all individuals have access to essential health services.
 
• Focuses on affordability, accessibility and quality of care.
 
 
 
• Aam Aadmi Party Governance Model__
 
 
• Emphasises free healthcare, free education and welfare-oriented public services.
 
• The scheme fulfills AAP’s pre-election health guarantee.
 
 

5d:T

questions.question: Which scheme aims to build a self-reliant and globally competitive semiconductor chip design ecosystem in India?

options.text: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Electronics

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology highlighted the role of the Design Linked Incentive Scheme in catalysing India’s semiconductor design ecosystem.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Design Linked Incentive Scheme operates under the Semicon India Programme.**
 
• It focuses on strengthening India’s semiconductor chip design capabilities rather than fabrication.
 
• Twenty-four DLI-supported projects target strategic sectors such as drones, satellite communication, microprocessors and IoT.
 
• Design Linked Incentive Scheme__ 
 __
 
• Encourages domestic fabless chip design companies
 
• Supports innovation, IP creation and commercialisation
 
• Aims to build a globally competitive chip design ecosystem
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Semiconductor Chip Design__

 __
 
• Contributes up to 50% of total value addition in semiconductors
 
• Accounts for 20–50% of Bill of Materials cost
 
• Drives 30–35% of global semiconductor sales through the fabless model
 
 
 
• India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)__
 __
 
• Anchors India’s semiconductor strategy
 
• Strengthens domestic supply chains and ecosystem
 
• Supports manufacturing, design and innovation initiatives
 
 
 
• DLI Scheme Outcomes__
 
 
• Sixteen tape-outs and six ASIC chips achieved
 
• More than ten patents generated
 
• Over one thousand engineers engaged with more than three times private investment leveraged

questions.question: The 'Atal Pension Yojana' (APY) is available to Indian citizens between ____ years of age.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18-40 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)** is a social security scheme aimed at providing pension benefits to individuals from the unorganized sector.
 
• This scheme is available to Indian citizens aged between **18 to 40 years**.
 
• The scheme guarantees a minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 upon reaching the age of 60, depending on the contribution made during the enrollment period.
 
• Individuals need to contribute regularly to the scheme for at least 20 years to avail of the pension benefits.
 
• The **Government of India** co-contributes 50% of the total contribution or Rs. 1,000 per annum, whichever is lower, for eligible subscribers.
 
• APY is regulated and administered by the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (20-55 years):**

 
 
• This age group is not applicable to the Atal Pension Yojana.
 
• However, pension schemes like the **National Pension System (NPS)** allow enrollment for individuals up to the age of 65 years.
 
• While APY specifically targets unorganized sector workers, NPS is a voluntary retirement savings scheme available for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 (18-45 years):**
 
 
• The age range of 18-45 years is incorrect for APY.
 
• APY mandates an upper limit of 40 years for enrollment to ensure sufficient contributions are made before retirement age.
 
• Other schemes like PMJJBY (Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana) and PMSBY (Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana) have different age eligibility criteria.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 (21-58 years):**
 
 
• This age range is unrelated to the Atal Pension Yojana.
 
• For schemes like the Employees’ Provident Fund, broader age ranges may apply, but such schemes are primarily meant for salaried individuals in the organized sector.
 
 
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana (APY):**
 
 
• It was launched in 2015 by the Government of India under the leadership of PM Narendra Modi.
 
• The scheme aims to promote financial security and old-age protection for workers in the unorganized sector.
 
• Subscribers can use their **Aadhaar-linked bank account** for automatic deductions of contributions.
 
• It provides an affordable and reliable pension system and helps increase financial inclusion in India.

questions.question: How many households have adopted rooftop solar power under the PM Surya Ghar scheme as of February 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**30 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded the milestone of 30 lakh households adopting rooftop solar under the PM Surya Ghar scheme in February 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Prime Minister hailed the achievement of empowering 30 lakh households across the nation with rooftop solar power under the PM Surya Ghar scheme as a commendable milestone in India’s clean energy journey.**
 
• **This milestone boosts savings, sustainability, self-reliance, and contributes to building an energy-secure, green, and future-ready India.**
 
• **The scheme, launched in February 2024, is officially known as PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, with a target of installing rooftop solar in one crore households by 2026-27.**
 
• PM Surya Ghar Scheme__
 __
 
• Full name - PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
 
• Launch year - 2024
 
• Current milestone - 30 lakh households with rooftop solar
 
• Target - 1 crore households by 2026-27
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Rooftop Solar Power__

 __
 
• Installation of solar panels on household rooftops to generate electricity, reducing dependence on grid power and enabling bill savings through net metering or direct consumption.
 
 
 
• PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana__
 __
 
• Central government scheme providing subsidies and support for rooftop solar installations to make electricity "free" (muft bijli) up to a certain limit for households.
 
• Aims to promote clean renewable energy adoption at the household level.
 
 
 
• Clean Energy Journey__
 
 
• Refers to India's push towards renewable sources like solar to reduce carbon emissions, enhance energy security, and achieve sustainability goals.

questions.question: Which mechanism was implemented by the PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) scheme, notified in September 2024, to allow EV buyers to claim demand incentives?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**E-vouchers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Under the PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) scheme, demand incentives for electric vehicle (EV) buyers are provided in the form of **e-vouchers**.
 
• E-vouchers are issued to eligible consumers after verification of their EV purchase and adherence to scheme guidelines.
 
• The e-vouchers can be redeemed directly at the time of purchase of an EV, significantly reducing the upfront cost for buyers.
 
• This mechanism ensures transparency and reduces fraudulent claims, as the vouchers are linked to the buyer’s identity and purchase records.
 
• The scheme aims to promote faster adoption of EVs in India by making them more affordable and accessible to the general public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reward Points**

 
 
• Reward points are typically used in loyalty programs offered by businesses to customers as a way of incentivizing purchases or engagements.
 
• While effective in customer retention strategies, they are not commonly used in government subsidy or incentive schemes.
 
• This mechanism does not align with the operational goals of the PM E-DRIVE scheme, which focuses on immediate financial relief for EV buyers.
 
 
 
• **Subsidy Certificates**
 
 
• Subsidy certificates are physical or digital certificates issued to individuals or entities eligible for subsidies.
 
• While they can be used to avail of benefits, they may involve additional administrative steps for verification and redemption, leading to delays.
 
• The PM E-DRIVE scheme emphasizes streamlined and direct benefits, making e-vouchers a more suitable mechanism than subsidy certificates.
 
 
 
• **Eco-Incentive Grants**
 
 
• Eco-incentive grants are financial aids provided to promote environmentally friendly practices.
 
• These grants are generally allocated to businesses or organizations rather than individuals.
 
• The PM E-DRIVE scheme specifically targets individual EV buyers, making e-vouchers a more appropriate and targeted mechanism for this purpose.

questions.question: Which scheme will provide health benefits to gig workers registered on the e-Shram portal in 2025?

options.text: Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ayushman Bharat PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) is a flagship health insurance scheme launched by the Government of India under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
 
• It is the **world’s largest government-funded health insurance scheme**, aiming to provide free healthcare access to low-income families.
 
• The scheme offers a health coverage of **up to Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year** for secondary and tertiary hospitalization in both public and private empanelled hospitals across India.
 
• The gig workers registered under the e-Shram portal will benefit from this scheme starting in 2025, ensuring access to quality healthcare services.
 
• This initiative is an important step towards providing universal health coverage and strengthening the healthcare system in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)**

 
 
• The Atal Pension Yojana, launched in 2015, is a government-backed pension scheme aimed at providing social security to workers in the unorganized sector.
 
• It guarantees a fixed pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month, depending on the contribution made by the subscriber.
 
• APY is available for individuals aged 18 to 40, and the pension begins at the age of 60.
 
• The scheme is administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)**
 
 
• PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme launched in 2019 to provide income support to small and marginal farmers.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible farmers receive **Rs. 6,000 annually in three equal installments**, directly transferred to their bank accounts.
 
• It aims to ensure financial stability for farmers and support them in meeting agricultural and domestic needs.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**
 
 
• PMAY is a housing scheme launched in 2015 to provide affordable housing to urban and rural poor by 2022.
 
• The scheme has two components: PMAY-Urban and PMAY-Gramin, catering to urban and rural areas, respectively.
 
• It provides financial assistance for constructing or upgrading houses and aims for “Housing for All.”

questions.question: On March 13, 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi released the 22nd installment of the PM-KISAN scheme from which city?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Guwahati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi released the 22nd installment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme from Guwahati, Assam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disbursement:** More than **₹18,640 crore** was transferred directly to the bank accounts of over **9.32 crore** farmer families.
 
• **Milestone:** The total cumulative amount transferred under PM-KISAN has now crossed the historic mark of **₹4.27 lakh crore**.
 
• **Women Empowerment:** Over **2.15 crore women farmers** received financial assistance in this installment.
 
• **Tech Integration:** The scheme uses **Face-Authentication** and an AI chatbot named **"Kisan-eMitra"** (available in 11 languages) to assist farmers.
 
• **Verification:** A "Voluntary Surrender" facility exists for affluent farmers to opt-out, ensuring benefits reach the most deserving.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM-KISAN Scheme__

 __
 
• Launched in **February 2019** (effective from Dec 2018), it provides **₹6,000 per year** in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to eligible landholding farmer families.
 
 
 
• Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)__
 
 
• A mechanism used by the Government of India to transfer subsidies directly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries to reduce leakages and delays.
 
 

85:T14

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) was launched on 1 January 2017 and completed 9 years in 2026, providing maternal financial support and nutrition benefits.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PMMVY provides partial wage compensation, encourages institutional deliveries, and reduces maternal and infant malnutrition.**
 
• Financial assistance: ₹5,000 for the first child in two instalments, ₹6,000 for the second child in one instalment.
 
• Eligibility: First two living children, with the second child being a girl; excludes women in government employment or receiving similar benefits.
 
• Benefits are transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and monitored digitally through PMMVYSoft for real-time supervision and grievance redressal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Scheme Details__

 __
 
• Launched under Ministry of Women and Child Development to support maternal wellbeing, nutrition, and institutional deliveries.
 
• Integrated under Mission Shakti (Samarthya component) for women’s economic empowerment and scheme convergence.
 
 
 
• Financial Assistance__
 __
 
• First instalment of ₹3,000 after pregnancy registration and first antenatal check-up.
 
• Second instalment of ₹2,000 after childbirth and completion of mandatory vaccinations for first child; ₹6,000 for second child in one instalment.
 
 
 
• Funding Pattern__
 __
 
• Centre-State: 60:40; NE & special category states: 90:10; UTs without legislature: fully central funding.
 
• Over 4.05 crore beneficiaries covered with ₹19,000 crore disbursed by December 2025.
 
 
 
• Monitoring and Technology__
 
 
• PMMVYSoft launched in March 2023 for digital monitoring, transparency, and grievance redressal.
 
• Ensures real-time supervision of scheme implementation across India.
